claims.content: The Customer completes the checkout process by selecting a payment method, choosing shipping speed, and confirming payment for won auction items.

goal.raw_text: The Customer completes the checkout process by selecting a payment method, choosing shipping speed, and confirming payment for won auction items.

claims.content: Customer
The Customer has won an auction.
The system has checked the winner's payment method type in their registration data.
If the Customer has a stored credit card, the automated checkout process is ready to trigger upon winning.
If the Customer uses PayPal or Amazon Payments as default, they have received a 'Congratulations Winner' email instructing them to sign in and provide payment information.
The Customer has unpaid auction winnings within seven days (168 hours) of the auction's closing date/time.
When an auction ends, the system will check the winner's payment method type in their registration data, and proceed according to payment method.

trigger.raw_text: When an auction ends, the system will check the winner's payment method type in their registration data, and proceed according to payment method.

claims.content: If the Customer has stored credit card information, the system automatically processes the order.
The system sends the winner an order confirmation email.
If the Customer uses PayPal or Amazon Payments as their default payment method, they receive a 'Congratulations Winner!' email instructing them to sign in and provide payment information.
Customers with unpaid auction winnings see a 'Winings Alert' in place of the normal promotional text bar.
When the user clicks on the 'Winings Alert' link, they are taken to the 'Returning Winners Payments' page.
The 'Returning Winners Payments' page displays a personalized Welcome Back Winner! Message.
The Customer completes the payment transaction within seven days (168 hours) of the auction's closing date/time.
If the Customer fails to complete transactions within seven days (168 hours), their account may be suspended.
Orders not paid for with Amazon or PayPal within 168 hours of being won will be cancelled, and the item placed into a 'Hold' status.
If the Customer does not pay for the order with Amazon or PayPal within 168 hours of being won, the order will be cancelled and the item placed into a 'Hold' status.
When orders are cancelled due to non-payment, the system triggers an automated email to the second-place finisher (if one exists) offering to sell the item at their last bid price.
If the second-place finisher clicks 'Decline Option' ('No Thanks'), the item is released from hold status back into auction available inventory.

If the second-place finisher does not respond to the 2nd-Chance email within 72 hours after the email is sent, the item will be returned to auction available inventory and rescheduled for a future auction.
The 2nd-Chance email will not be sent if the 2nd-place finisher's bid is below the item's unit cost.
The Customer is returned to a Thank You page, which uses the global header and footer, and includes a prominent link to the JTVauctions.com home page.
The order confirmation email has been sent to the winner (for credit card payments).
Payment for the won items has been successfully processed via the selected method (PayPal, Amazon Payments, or stored credit card).
